text:
maria (partnerships): Quick heads-up: LangChain wants a joint customer-facing demo with SigmaCompute that routes through our gateway + Redwood runtime. Can we outline owners and the preflight checklist?
aj (eng): Need a demo cluster that matches Dedicated behavior (batching + KV cache). Who can provision and by when?
kevin (devex): I can provision sandbox-us-west. Drop model ref, quant, and 3 short + 2 long prompts and Ill warm caches.
lee (sigma): Sigma can provide a container image and a 1-pager quickstart for marketplace listing. Will share by Apr 5.
tom (product): Demo goals: 1) show LangChain chain invoking an external tool via gateway -> redwood runtime -> Sigma GPU; 2) visible latency & cost metrics; 3) graceful fallback to smaller model. Keep the demo < 4 minutes.
jen (marketing): Co-marketing asks: co-branded one-pager, 60s demo clip, social assets, and embargo date. Legal needs 72h to approve partner quotes.
aj (eng): Ill create scoped demo service accounts (24h TTL) for LangChain and Sigma engineers. No prod creds. Also wiring a fallback route to a quantized CPU model.
kevin (devex): Example config Ill test with:
```yaml
model: redwood/gpt-mid-cpu
quant: int8
batching: burst-24
cache: prefix-enabled
```
maria (partnerships): Proposed timeline: Apr 10 internal run, Apr 16 partner dress rehearsal, Apr 20 final smoke. Owners: Jen -> assets/embargo, Aj -> keys & fallback, Kevin -> infra, Tom -> script & failure plan, Maria -> partner comms.
langchain-bot: Reminder: add LangChain demo app repo access request form: https://internal.redwood/links/langchain-access
jen (marketing): Target embargo Apr 21, publish Apr 22. Will confirm after legal signoff on Apr 18.
kevin (devex): Agree. Ill capture boot-to-ready timings (goal < 90s) and a short runbook for the demo.
maria (partnerships): Great. If Sigma can deliver the image by Apr 5 and LangChain confirms prompts by Apr 7 were on track. Ping blockers here. :rocket:
